basic_info.description: (Ahem!) Pardon our dust while the building is constructing you an all new Rooftop Lounge!!    And now for the main event! ... Prominently located in Hayes Valley, 8 Octavia #602 resides within one of the most distinguished and iconic buildings in all of San Francisco! Designed by legendary architect Stanley Saitowitz, this modern and refined 1001 sqft 2-bedroom/ 2-bathroom home beams with nearly impossible to find natural light, westwardly views, floor-to-ceiling windows, and 7.5" wide plank Austrian Oak flooring.  The home's top-of-the-line accented home amenities include: Liebherr refrigerator, SieMatic kitchen cabinets, white Corian countertops, Duravit fixtures, Nest Temperature control, and Webpass building-wide internet service!  Even more, the building offers you top-notch privacy with tap keyless entry, virtual doorman service, and its soon built exclusive building-only rooftop lounge which will showcase 360 panoramic views of San Francisco!  Welcome to your new home in the heart of San Francisco!
